onChange.template: [Category: movement] Apply the Dynamic art style to Rotation. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.
[Category: movement] Apply the Smooth art style to Rotation. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.
[Category: movement] Apply the Precise art style to Rotation. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/rotation.schema.json, set rotc_mode to {{rotc_mode}}]
Set strafeMode to {{rotc_mode}} in MovementAbility. Face Move Dir=false, Strafe=true.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/rotation.schema.json, set rott_rotation_speed to {{rott_rotation_speed}}]
Set rotationSpeed to {{rott_rotation_speed}} in MovementAbility.
